payload.title: Store sessions on Linux and Windows, in memory on cloud machines, with per-key locks
payload.description: Owner: Papyrus session. stores/secret_service.py, stores/kernel_keyring.py (probe first: Docker's default seccomp blocks keyctl/add_key), stores/agent.py (memory-only, 0600 Unix socket, '<product> auth agent --status|stop', never on disk), stores/windows.py (Credential Manager; refresh token only, 2,560-byte blob limit), in that order after macOS, each failing closed with recovery guidance and never plaintext. Backends named explicitly. locks.py: one fcntl/LockFileEx lock per key. Specs with fake backends; locked/absent stores; concurrent refresh and logout; symlink and permission refusal; fresh child processes; CI on Linux, macOS and Windows.
